senses.en_definition: A period of twelve months, used to measure age or duration.
A calendar year identified by its number.
A numbered twelve-month period in the publication history of a magazine, newspaper, or similar publication.
A twelve-month period designated for a particular activity or purpose.
A crop's growing cycle or season, in certain agricultural expressions.

collocations.en: a maize-growing season, lasting about three or four months
one rice-growing cycle, lasting about five or six months

messages.en: Are we still going to Langkawi this year?
This year's a bit tricky. I've used up all my leave. How about next year instead?
Sure. Let's pick the dates early next year so it's easier to apply for leave.
You still haven't eaten after all this time?
I'm not that hungry anyway. I'll go out and get something in a bit.
Maybe we were meant to run into each other here, eh?
Yeah, it's been ages. Come on, let's grab a drink!

senses.en_definition: Will not; a colloquial contraction of tidak akan.
Used in rhetorical questions to express disbelief or suggest that something is impossible or unlikely.

collocations.en: surely it can't be like that?

messages.en: I'm going to sleep till noon tomorrow. This week's been exhausting.
Surely you haven't forgotten we're meeting at ten tomorrow?
Oh no, good thing you reminded me! I'll set an alarm now.
